messages.title: Automatic messages
messages.description: Schedule daily or weekly announcements from the web.
messages.behavior: Barman must stay online to send messages. The scheduler checks every 30 seconds and sends at most once per day at your chosen local time and timezone. Missed schedules are not caught up. Discord mentions in the text may notify their recipients.
messages.saveFirst: Save the message first, then add an attachment. For attachment-only messages, upload the file, then clear the text and save.
messages.attachmentHelp: Maximum 8 MiB. Files are sent by the bot, not published on the website. Attachment changes are saved separately from the text.
messages.confirmDelete: Delete automatic message “{{name}}” and stop future deliveries?
messages.empty: No automatic messages yet. Create your first announcement!
messages.missing: This automatic message no longer exists in this guild.
messages.missingChannel: Channel not found in this server.
messages.channelPermission: The bot must be able to view the channel and send messages.
messages.attachmentPermission: The bot needs Send Messages and Attach Files in this channel.
messages.contentRequired: The message needs text or a saved attachment.
messages.duplicate: This name is already used in this guild.
messages.unavailable: Discord is unavailable. Check that the bot is connected.
messages.error: Unable to load or save messages. Check the content, channel and schedule.

banner.title: Voice banner
banner.heading: Bring your voice channels to life
banner.description: Place voice-channel avatars on your server banner and let the bot keep it updated.
banner.requirements: Discord must support server banners, and the bot needs Manage Server. You can prepare the configuration here even if these requirements are not yet met.
banner.dragHint: Drag a channel’s avatar to position it, or use arrow keys (Shift: 10 pixels). Save the position below. The preview shows one 64 px sample avatar per channel, not the final live composition.
banner.imageHelp: Static PNG, JPEG or WebP · Maximum 8 MiB / 16 megapixels. Uploads are cropped to 960 × 540 pixels; existing backgrounds keep their original size.
banner.confirmDisable: Disable automatic banner updates? The current banner on Discord and channel positions will be kept.
banner.saved: Banner settings saved. Discord will update on the next voice-state change.
banner.howTitle: A banner that follows the conversation
banner.behavior: Barman redraws the banner when a voice state changes, using the avatars of people in each configured channel. Changes saved here take effect on that next event. The bot must run with Manage Server permission, and Discord’s server-banner feature must be available.
banner.empty: No voice channels configured yet. Choose one and position its avatar on the preview.
banner.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}” from the banner? The Discord voice channel will not be deleted.
banner.missingChannel: Voice channel not found in this server. It may have been deleted.
banner.duplicate: This voice channel is already configured for the banner.
banner.imageError: Unable to display the background. Upload a new image to replace it.
banner.error: Unable to load or update the voice banner. Check the image and channel settings, then try again.

acceptance.title: Rules acceptance
acceptance.description: Choose the message and emoji members use to accept this server’s rules.
acceptance.messageHelp: In Discord, right-click the message → Copy Message Link. You can also use its ID with Developer Mode enabled. Links are checked against the selected server.
acceptance.behavior: Add this reaction to the message on Discord. Reacting accepts the rules and allows level-role assignment; removing the reaction revokes acceptance and level roles. Changing or disabling this setting does not reset existing acceptances.
acceptance.confirmDisable: Disable the acceptance message? Existing acceptances and assigned roles will be kept.
acceptance.foreignGuild: This message belongs to another Discord server. Use a message from the selected server.
acceptance.missingMessage: Message or channel not found in this server. Check the link and the bot’s access to the channel.
acceptance.noAccess: The bot cannot read this message. Allow View Channel and Read Message History.
acceptance.error: Unable to load or save this setting. Check the message link or ID and try again.

roles.title: Roles
roles.heading: Give every member their place
roles.description: Connect your Discord roles to levels or reactions, without slash commands.
roles.levelHelp: Members who have accepted the rules receive their highest eligible configured level role. Changes synchronize tracked members automatically.
roles.reactionHelp: Copy a message ID from this server using Discord Developer Mode. Members gain the role when adding the configured reaction and lose it when removing it. Add the initial reaction on Discord yourself. Unicode emoji, custom emoji mentions, and legacy custom emoji names are supported.
roles.howTitle: Two ways to unlock a role
roles.permissionsHelp: The bot needs Manage Roles, and its highest role must be above the configured roles. Your own role hierarchy also applies. Managed, @everyone, and roles granting Administrator, Manage Roles or Manage Server cannot be used for automatic assignment.
roles.emptyHelp: Choose an existing Discord role and its unlock condition to get started.
roles.confirmDelete: Remove the rule for “{{name}}”? The Discord role will not be deleted. Old level assignments will be cleaned up; existing reaction-role assignments remain.
roles.synced: Level roles synchronized for {{count}} tracked members.
roles.partialSync: Configuration saved, but {{failed}} member updates failed. Check the bot’s permissions and affected members. You can retry active level rules with Synchronize; removed rules may need manual role cleanup.
roles.error: Unable to update role management. Please try again.
roles.unavailable: Discord is unavailable. Check that the bot is connected.
roles.managedRole: Managed by Discord or an integration
roles.botHierarchy: Move the bot’s role above this role
roles.actorHierarchy: This role is above or equal to your highest role
roles.privilegedRole: Privileged roles cannot be automatically assigned
roles.missingRole: This Discord role no longer exists in the server.
roles.missingRule: This role rule no longer exists in this guild.
roles.duplicateRole: This Discord role already has a rule in this guild.
roles.duplicateLevel: Another role already uses this level. Choose another level.

members.title: Members
members.heading: Manage your guild’s members
members.description: Adjust smartpoints, levels and current-level XP in one place.
members.search: Search by name, username or Discord ID…
members.exactValues: Enter exact values, then apply each member’s changes. XP is progress within the selected level (200 × level, capped at 3,000 XP). Manual adjustments do not grant level-up money, wallpapers or monthly XP.
members.invalid: Use whole numbers, a level of at least 1, non-negative smartpoints, and XP between 0 and {{max}}.
members.loadError: Unable to load members. Please try again.
members.saveError: Unable to save these changes. Your edits are kept so you can retry.
members.departed: This member is no longer in this Discord server.

admin.imageDimensions: Images are cropped and saved at 500 × 281 pixels.
admin.replaceWallpaperImageHint: Choose a new image, then click Replace image. The wallpaper keeps its price, level and owners. Previewing does not save the image; other edits are saved separately.
admin.wallpaperEditHint: Set price or level to 0 to disable that unlock method. Existing owners keep their wallpaper; level rewards are not retroactive.
